first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ, which is the most immediately addressable metric among the three pressures. Memory 91 showed activation_messaging improved week-one engagement and drove first meaningful action; memory 86 confirmed onboarding improvements lift adoption. Verifying memory_31 and memory_91 will clarify whether the activation decline stems from messaging degradation (solvable via in-product messaging refinement) versus structural onboarding friction. Activation_messaging is lower-risk than promotional_pricing (which could erode margins against competitor pressure without addressing core engagement) and referral_incentive (which requires established customer base health we haven't verified). Enterprise_sales_assist is orthogonal to the current SMB-focused pressure. A standard_experiment on activation_messaging targets the 6% decline directly and can execute within a week while preserving the option to pivot to pricing or onboarding if this round doesn't move the needle.
